I'm sorry, that's frustrating after following the care card. Losing more than a third of its leaves counts as significant decline under our Plant Care Guarantee, so you may qualify for one free replacement of the same plant (store credit if it's out of stock).

The guarantee runs 30 days from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members, on plants ordered while the membership was active), so please file soon if you're near the end of that window. Go to "My Orders" and submit a claim with at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back.

The claim isn't covered if the plant was repotted into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days, or if pests or deliberate neglect were involved. You can also chat or email a Plant Care Specialist for free advice on the plant in the meantime.
